messages:
nora_partners: Heads-up: APAC SI onboarding ran into customs+SKU mismatch today. Partner couldn't redeem voucher because local SKU required tax ID. Need a short playbook for regional SKU mapping + customs fallback.

ashley_ops: Oh no. Which country? If it's SG/HK we usually have fast vendor workarounds; if it's Indonesia there are more steps. Can we collect recent incidents and distill a 2-page decision tree?

rami_si: I'll share the incident notes. Also propose a two-track solution: (A) marketplace-voucher flow where voucher covers HW only and partner pays duties, (B) reseller-assisted flow where vendor invoices local tax and we reimburse. Need legal input.

devon_marketplace: I'll export SKU -> local_offer mapping and flag offers with known customs friction. I can also add a short sample email vendors can use to request extra docs.

si-helper-bot: Created task #P-9002 "Regional SKU & Customs Playbook" assigned to devon_marketplace, due 2024-07-12.

ashley_ops: Steps to include: 1) pre-check list to run with partner (taxID, commercial invoice acceptance), 2) if reseller flow required, contact vendor template, 3) timeline expectations (customs add 3-10 business days).

nora_partners: Also add a mentor-specific note: mentors shouldn't start a cohort until interop checkbox is ticked and voucher confirmed. That prevented wasted mentor hours today.

rami_si: For mentor gating, suggest: confirmation email + screenshot of voucher redemption + interop script output. We can make a single Slack snippet mentors paste to request confirmation.

devon_marketplace: Will produce the mapping CSV + short flow doc by EOD Friday. I'll add a column for 'tax covered by voucher? yes/no'.

nora_partners: Thanks all. Quick recap: owner list and ETA: mapping + doc = devon_marketplace by Fri; decision tree + mentor gate = ashley_ops + rami_si by next Wed. We'll reconvene in this thread when drafts are in.

si-helper-bot: Meeting scheduled: Regional SI customs sync 024-07-15 09:00 UTC. Invite sent."
